notes.title: Small patch
notes.notes: Hot fixed the item description on Linux.

notes.title: Small visual update (again)
notes.notes: Yup, new stuff coming and we are starting with the visuals. We wanted to bring an aesthetic less plain, more colorful and full of elements.

notes.title: Small visual update
notes.notes: Added new visuals for the game.

notes.title: We're now on Linux
notes.notes:
We'll keep updating this game, bringing it to its glory as much as we can.
Recently we added autosave, an obvious must-have. Now we are natively integrating it to OSs other than Windows.
Maybe get an easy mode to learn to play. We can even make a game journalist dedicated difficulty.

Hope you enjoy the game and there might be more updates to come.

notes.title: Added autosave
notes.notes: We've added an autosave feature to make progress more forgiving. Your run will now auto-save at the start of every night (also saves progress on infinite mode), to help you jump back in without losing too much progress.

notes.title: Achievements
notes.notes:
NOIRCOTICS now has 39 unique achievements for you to obtain.

Yeah that's it.
Have fun.
